title: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
summary: Crypto wallet providers must submit an early vulnerability report within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours of exploits, or risk administrative fines of as much as $17.3 million.

title: CLARITY Act vote meets Fed rate hike: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
summary: Bitcoin traders brace for volatility as the CLARITY Act awaits a Senate vote to move forward and the Fed is due to announce its latest rate decision.

title: Symbiosis says recovered 15 BTC from bridge hack, offers 20% bounty
summary: Symbiosis is offering a 20% bounty for information leading to asset recovery after the hacker refused to return the stolen funds for the same white-hat bounty.

title: UK FCA seeks views on fund rule exemptions for tokenized gold
summary: The FCA said uncertainty over whether some tokenized gold products fall under UK fund rules could affect adoption and investor access.

title: King Charles to host AI chiefs amid industry call to slow development

title: Robinhood CEO says issuers should not have veto over tokenized stocks
summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said issuers should be involved if tokenized products change shareholder rights or company obligations, but not when they create separate instruments backed by shares.
